# goldenmatch (TypeScript)

> Entity resolution toolkit — deduplicate, match, and create golden records

## Install
```bash
npm install goldenmatch
```

## Authoritative sources
Read these instead of inferring behaviour from the compiled `dist/`:
- This file -- ships INSIDE the package: `node_modules/goldenmatch/llms.txt`.
- https://docs.bensevern.dev/docs/goldenmatch -- full docs.
- https://github.com/benseverndev-oss/goldenmatch -- source + issues.
- Python sibling (the reference implementation): `pip install goldenmatch` -- same concepts, fuller surface.

## Notes
Edge-safe: runs in browsers, Cloudflare Workers, Vercel Edge and Deno. Optional WASM (`await enableWasm()`) swaps in the Rust score-core kernel; pure TS is the default and the classified fallback.

This is part of the Golden Suite. Suite-level index: https://docs.bensevern.dev/docs/llms.txt

Behaviour here is *decided* and contract-tested against the Python
implementation, not incidental. Reading `dist/` shows what one path does; it
does not show which guarantees are load-bearing, which fallbacks are
deliberate, or which knobs exist.
